title: Shinonome Ena — I Don't Want To Give Up〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: I Don't Want To Give Up（4★）

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (The clouds covering up the sky need to stand out more...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And the sky needs to feel close but still unreachable. The rays of light should also be more transparent, but feel warm and bright...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (At this rate, I'll never be able to capture the melody Kanade came up with...!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know what I want to draw, but I can't...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: A genius wouldn't have to stop and think about every step they take. They'd just find a way and finish...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ugh... No, I don't have time to think about that!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Why? The more I draw, the further I get away from what I envisioned...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sigh... And Kanade's song went like...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? This melody seemed fine at first...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But it felt different when I heard it in SEKAI for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It is different. This might be why I can't draw the way I want to...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: One more time... I have to remember exactly how I felt back there...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: N25 needs you, Ena. It needs your art.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I have to keep drawing... No matter what, I have to keep trying!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I felt so lonely and it hurt so much that I felt like crying, but there was a certain warmth there...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It felt like I was suffering, but being consoled by someone's kind words at the same time...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Like this melody... Like someone was telling me that it's okay for me to be here...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, I have a much better idea of what I want to draw now!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? That sounded like it came from the hallway...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It's the juice and cheesecake I usually get...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, Akito. It's like you can read my mind sometimes...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wait, the receipt's in here too...!
So... He wants me to pay him back?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I didn't even ask him to get me these.
Doesn't that mean this is a gift?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Well, I'll graciously accept his gratitude today.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Now, I have a solid image in my head, so it's time to finish this thing off! Right after a midnight snack...
